# GithubSpy — Complete Technical Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive architectural and algorithmic reference for GithubSpy.

## Overview
GithubSpy (https://githubspy.vercel.app/) provides open-source maintainer intelligence, contribution velocity metrics, and applicant feasibility scoring for any public GitHub repository.

## Architecture
- Framework: Vite 5, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Data Ingestion:
  - Single-request GraphQL pipeline (queries repo info, 100 recent PRs, review statuses, and author associations in 1 roundtrip)
  - Throttled REST API fallback with GitHub Search API on-demand lookups
- Multi-tier Caching:
  - Memory-level LRU cache + Browser LocalStorage persistence with 10-minute TTL and stale-while-revalidate mechanics
- Security:
  - Content Security Policy (CSP), Subresource Integrity, Strict Transport Security (HSTS), Zero Tracking, Zero Third-Party Analytics
- Licensing:
  - Strict Protective Source License (SPSL-1.0)
